assumptions.statement: Error bodies for 400/403 are asserted strictly as { errors: [ { code, message } ] } with a single error; the 409 body as bare { code, message }; the 404 of a missing schema/instance read as an empty body.
assumptions.evidence: spec.md Access baseline header; runs/016-rename-resource-schema/discovery/raw/q2.json (F-2: ExceptionToResponseMapper ErrorsResponse, Results.NotFound())

assumptions.statement: Baseline rows that cannot differ before/after the rename were folded into a test with a row that does, so every contract test is red-first: member and outsider rows 3+4 in one test each; outsider rows 11, 12, 14, 15 in one test; member row 14 additionally asserts rows carry resourceSchemaId.
assumptions.default_chosen: Fold inherently-green rows into a red test of the same operation family
assumptions.rationale: Constitution V rejects tests that pass before the behaviour exists; AC-10/AC-11 still need every row asserted.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If one test per row is required, split the combined tests; assertions stay identical.

assumptions.statement: AC-2 test file is named RemovedTypesAddressesTests.cs instead of tasks.md's RemovedResourceTypeAddressesTests.cs, and negative-assertion literals for the old name (AC-6, AC-9, AC-13, frontend) are built by string concatenation, so the FR-009/FR-011 repository search for the old name stays clean in test code.

assumptions.statement: AC-9 runs on a separate database created in the test container; the ResourcesDbContext for it is built with ActivatorUtilities from the app's DI options plus Database.SetConnectionString; the old DataType column literal (number vs name) is read from information_schema at run time.

assumptions.rationale: Migration source is outside the tester's read scope; this avoids guessing migrations assembly or column types. Verified green.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Test fails at arrange with a clear DB error; adjust the helper only.

assumptions.statement: The new frontend resources-api.service.spec.ts locates the service class from the module's runtime exports and calls the methods by the data-model.md names (getResourceSchemas, getResourceSchema, createResourceSchema(payload), updateResourceSchema(id, payload), deleteResourceSchema(id)); the create-instance method is found as the only create* method not containing 'schema'; Observable or Promise results are both handled.

assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If createResourceSchema takes (groupId, payload) the URL/method assertion still holds; if the service class is not providedIn root it is provided explicitly; a differently named create-instance method that starts with 'create' is still found.
